ruleset.name: quay
ruleset.description: Unused code, plus size limits set at the measured ceiling of this codebase. Cyclomatic complexity 16 and NPath 8192 are the current ceilings (ProblemResponse::describe is a flat exception map with NPath 8192). A higher value fails. This is not a file baseline. Clean-code static-access and controversial rules are omitted because Laravel facades are normal here.
